list_resources: Shows you every workload, service, and config that lives inside a cluster.
get_resource: Opens up a single Kubernetes object and shows you what it looks like right now.
list_pods: Lists the running containers (pods) in a cluster or namespace so you can see what is alive.
get_pod_logs: Pulls the recent log output from a container so you can read what it has been saying.
describe_pod: Gives you the full story of a pod — why it started, why it failed, and what it is waiting on.
list_nodes: Lists the machines (nodes) that are powering the cluster and how busy each one is.
get_node_metrics: Shows how much CPU and memory each machine in the cluster is currently using.
list_deployments: Shows the rollouts that keep your apps running and tells you if any are unhealthy.
list_services: Lists the network addresses the cluster exposes so traffic can reach your apps.
list_events: Shows the timeline of things Kubernetes has recently decided, succeeded at, or complained about.
analyze_cluster_health: Gives you a one-glance health report for the whole cluster with the biggest problems called out first.
analyze_pod_failures: Looks at failing pods and explains, in plain language, why they are not healthy.
analyze_resource_usage: Tells you which workloads are using the most CPU and memory and whether they are wasting it.
analyze_blast_radius: Shows what would break if a given service, node, or config went down right now.
recommend_optimizations: Suggests concrete changes that would make the cluster cheaper, safer, or more reliable.
recommend_security_fixes: Points out the security issues that actually matter and tells you how to fix each one.
troubleshoot_pod: Walks through a failing pod step by step and lands on the most likely root cause.
troubleshoot_service: Checks a service end to end — DNS, endpoints, pods, network — to find what is broken.
scale_deployment: Changes how many copies of an app are running. Requires an approval step.
restart_deployment: Restarts an app by rolling its pods. Requires an approval step.
